title: Strike reduces operations at Orvan Grain Port

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port strike
facts.statement: Dock workers at Orvan Grain Port began a strike on 14 September 2026.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Realm Trade Ministry reports that dock workers at Orvan Grain Port began a strike on 14 September 2026.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port operations
facts.statement: Some grain berths are closed and the remaining berths are working at reduced speed.

source_ref.text_snippet: Some grain berths are closed and the remaining berths are working at reduced speed.

facts.subject: Vessels at Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: Vessels already in the roads are being held. New arrivals may be asked to wait outside the harbour.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vessels already in the roads are being held. New arrivals may be asked to wait outside the harbour.

facts.subject: Wheat and maize loadings
facts.statement: The ministry is monitoring the effect on wheat and maize loadings and will publish statistics in the normal way.

source_ref.text_snippet: The ministry is monitoring the effect on wheat and maize loadings and will publish statistics in the normal way.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port strike notice
facts.statement: The strike notice is the ministry's first public statement on the disruption.

source_ref.text_snippet: The strike notice is the ministry's first public statement on the disruption.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port operations
facts.statement: Exporters should expect delays and should not assume a quick return to normal working.

source_ref.text_snippet: Exporters should expect delays and should not assume a quick return to normal working.
